new_p_59: We believe that designing costumes for dancers requires more than just fabric and needle. Our studio combines the tradition of haute couture with artificial intelligence innovation to bring to the stage creations unlike anything seen before.
new_p_61: In the competitive dance world, every detail matters. Our team consists of professionals who understand movement, fabric, and technology. We are proud to be pioneers in the field of dance costume design that integrates advanced artificial intelligence tools into the creative process. This technology allows us to envision, sketch, and make precise adjustments even before cutting the first piece of fabric.
new_p_62: The use of artificial intelligence technologies gives our clients a significant advantage. We are able to produce realistic visualizations of the costume on stage, examine bold color combinations, and perfectly adapt the cut to the dancer's body structure and specific dance style. This is a winning combination between the heart and soul of the designer and the precision and efficiency of the computer.
new_p_63: Each team member brings unique expertise – from deep understanding of anatomy and movement, through mastery of traditional sewing techniques, to expertise in design software and generative AI. Together, we create a complete envelope for dancers and troupes who want to leave their mark on the stage.
new_p_67: With over 15 years of experience in the fashion and dance world, Regina leads the studio's design vision. She combines classical knowledge with openness to technological innovation.
new_p_70: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Design Expert
new_p_71: Amit is responsible for implementing artificial intelligence tools in the design process. He transforms abstract ideas into accurate visual simulations and assists in creating unique patterns.
new_p_75: Our expert in fabrics and cuts. Ronit ensures that every virtual design becomes a comfortable, durable, and impressive garment that allows the dancer to move with complete freedom.
new_p_78: We are here to turn your artistic vision into reality on stage. Contact us today for an initial consultation meeting.
new_p_81: "The stage is where dreams become movement. My role is to dress those dreams in a way that enhances every step and every gesture of the dancer."
new_p_83: Regina Sela began her path in the dance world as a young dancer, which gave her an intimate understanding of the physical and aesthetic needs of dancers on stage. After completing her studies at Shenkar College of Engineering, Design and Art, she decided to combine her two great loves: fashion and dance. For over 15 years, she has specialized in the field of dance costume design, working with leading companies in Israel and Europe.
new_p_84: Regina's uniqueness lies in her ability to see the big picture. She doesn't just design a garment, but creates a stage character. She understands how lighting affects fabric color, how the cut affects range of movement, and how the costume contributes to the story the choreographer is trying to tell.
new_p_86: In recent years, Regina has led a strategic move to implement artificial intelligence tools in the studio's work processes. The understanding that technology does not replace human creativity, but enhances it, is the foundation of her philosophy. The use of AI allows Regina to examine hundreds of variations of textures, shapes, and color combinations in record time.
new_p_87: "Artificial intelligence is like a skilled assistant who never gets tired," says Regina. "It allows me to break the boundaries of my imagination. I can input an abstract idea like 'wave movement in a stormy sea' and receive visual inspirations that are then translated into real cuts and fabrics. This completely changes the way we approach stage costume design."
new_p_89: "Excellent design is one that you see, but you feel the dancer. The costume must serve the artist, not dominate them. Technology helps us perfect this delicate balance."
new_p_91: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Design Expert
new_p_92: "We live in an era where the boundary between physical and digital is blurring. I'm here to ensure that technology serves art in the best possible way."
new_p_94: Amit Levi comes from a background in graphic design and software development, but his love for fashion has always been in the background. At Regina Sela's studio, Amit is responsible for the technological and innovative side of the creative process. He specializes in using generative AI tools to create unique fabric textures that don't exist in the commercial market.
new_p_95: The process begins with understanding the dance concept. Amit uses advanced algorithms to generate three-dimensional simulations of the costume on a body in motion. This allows clients to see exactly how the garment will look in a turn, jump, or stretch, and make real-time changes without the costs of sewing unnecessary samples.
new_p_97: One of the biggest challenges in dance costume design is the need for uniqueness. In international competitions, every visual detail can affect the score. With the tools that Amit developed and implemented in the studio, we can guarantee each troupe a design that is truly one of a kind.
new_p_98: "The use of artificial intelligence allows us to create complex patterns for digital printing on elastic fabrics," explains Amit. "We can create optical illusions that flatter the dancer's body, or reproduce historical textures with perfect accuracy. Technology doesn't replace the designer, it gives them an infinite toolbox."

new_p_104: "A beautiful garment that's not comfortable to dance in is a failure. My goal is to make the dancer forget they're wearing a costume and focus purely on performance."
new_p_106: Ronit Cohen is the technical anchor of the studio. With a degree in textile engineering and a decade of experience in sportswear development, she brings the practical knowledge that allows Regina's design visions and Amit's digital developments to become wearable reality. Ronit is responsible for material selection, elasticity testing, and adapting cuts to the human body in motion.
new_p_107: In the field of dance costume design, fabric selection is critical. The fabric must breathe, stretch, return to its original shape, and withstand harsh lighting conditions and perspiration. Ronit works closely with advanced fabric suppliers from around the world to locate the most innovative materials.
new_p_109: Ronit's role is also to ensure that the AI-generated products are manufacturable. Not everything that looks good on screen can be sewn in reality. Ronit serves as a 'translator' between the virtual world and the physical world. She analyzes the computerized models and finds creative solutions for their implementation – whether through special printing techniques, laser cutting, or ergonomic seams.
new_p_110: "When I see a dancer performing a complex lift and the garment moves with them in perfect harmony, I know we've done our job," says Ronit. "The combination of stunning design with precise garment engineering is what makes our studio a leader in its field."
about_h3_8: Meet the team that combines advanced technology with the art of fashion
about_p_18: Regina Sela Design was founded from a deep love for dance, fashion, and technology. We saw the enormous potential of artificial intelligence in fashion design and decided to create something new - a studio that combines the most advanced technology with human expertise and traditional artistry.
about_p_19: Since our establishment, we have created hundreds of stage costumes for dancers, dance companies, and competition participants from around the world. Each project is a new challenge, an opportunity to learn and grow, and a creative journey that ends with a costume that enhances the performance and leaves an unforgettable impression.
about_p_20: To turn every dancer and dance company into stars on stage through unique costumes that combine technological innovation, high quality, and stunning design. We are committed to creating costumes that not only look amazing, but also enhance performance and allow complete freedom of movement.
about_p_21: To lead the artificial intelligence revolution in the world of stage costume design, and make advanced technology accessible and available to every dancer and dance company. We want everyone who takes the stage to feel confident, beautiful, and ready to present their best.
about_p_22: We are always looking for new ways to integrate technology into the creative process and bring unique ideas that have never been seen before.
about_p_23: Every costume undergoes rigorous quality control and is sewn with utmost precision to ensure it will stand the test of time and use.
about_p_24: We believe that the best work is created through close collaboration with our clients, listening to and understanding their vision.
about_p_25: We love what we do, and it shows in every costume we create. Our passion for dance and fashion drives us forward.
about_p_26: We use the most advanced artificial intelligence tools on the market, which allow us to create designs that cannot be achieved through traditional methods. Technology helps us explore unlimited possibilities and find the perfect design for each project.
about_p_27: Despite using technology, we believe that human touch is the most important component. Every design undergoes professional manual processing, and every costume is carefully sewn by experienced artisans.
about_p_28: We don't believe in generic solutions. Every costume is personally customized for the dancer or dance company - from design, through fabrics, to the final fitting. The result is a costume that feels like it was created especially for you - because it really was created especially for you.
about_p_29: We accompany you throughout the entire process - from initial consultation to final delivery. We are available for questions, listen to feedback, and do everything we can to ensure you are completely satisfied with the result.

process_p_18: Our process is a unique combination of advanced technology, human expertise, and close collaboration with our clients. Each project is a creative journey that begins with an idea and ends with a costume that enhances performance and leaves an unforgettable impression.
process_p_19: We begin with an in-depth conversation to understand your artistic vision, dance style, movement requirements, and the message you want to convey. At this stage, we also examine the technical requirements - fabric type, preferred colors, budget, and timeline.
process_p_20: We use advanced AI tools to create dozens of design variations. The technology allows us to explore color combinations, patterns, and structures that couldn't be achieved through traditional methods. We create a wide range of ideas that reflect your vision.
process_p_21: We present the generated concepts to you and work together to choose the perfect design. Then, we integrate our human expertise to refine every detail - adapting the design to movement, examining proportions, and ensuring the costume will be comfortable and functional.
process_p_22: We create precise patterns and select the most suitable fabrics and materials. We emphasize quality, comfort, and durability - every costume must withstand performance conditions and maintain its perfect appearance.
process_p_23: The costume is sewn with great care, with attention to every detail. We incorporate advanced sewing techniques and add decorative elements - sequins, embroidery, sparkling stones, or any other detail that enriches the design.
process_p_24: We invite you for a final fitting to ensure perfect fit. We make final adjustments if needed and deliver the finished costume. Each costume comes with care and storage instructions to ensure it remains in perfect condition over time.
process_p_25: AI enables us to explore hundreds of design variations in a short time, and find creative solutions that wouldn't have occurred to us through traditional methods.
process_p_26: The technology helps us examine complex color combinations and find the perfect palette that will integrate with lighting and stage.
process_p_27: Creating complex geometric, organic, or abstract patterns that are difficult to create through traditional manual methods.
process_p_28: The accelerated process of creating concepts allows us to focus more on manual processing and execution perfection.
process_p_29: Despite using advanced technology, we believe that human touch is the most important component in the process. Every design undergoes professional manual processing, every stitch is done carefully, and every detail is examined with a critical eye.
process_p_30: Artificial intelligence is a tool that helps us explore possibilities and reach new ideas, but the real artistry is in our hands - in our ability to understand the dancer's needs, adapt the design to movement, and create a costume that enhances performance.
